data.one_liner: Dart SDK and client for Cloudflare APIs including Images, Stream, Live Inputs, and R2 storage.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart client for interacting with Cloudflare services. It supports managing and uploading images, streaming videos, live inputs, and S3-compatible R2 object storage operations.
use_when: You need to integrate Cloudflare Images, Stream, or Live Inputs into a Dart or Flutter application.
You are using Cloudflare R2 object storage and need an S3-compatible client implementation.
You need to perform direct or tus-protocol resumable video and image uploads.
avoid_when: You are looking for a general-purpose local database or device storage package.
You require backend services outside of what Cloudflare provides.
strengths: Covers multiple major Cloudflare services (Images, Stream, Live Inputs, R2).
Supports direct and resumable uploads using the tus protocol.
Compatible with both server-side Dart and client-side Flutter applications.
weaknesses: Exposing sensitive credentials directly in client-side applications requires careful use of direct upload flows.
Requires managing Cloudflare account IDs and API tokens or keys properly.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and initialize the Cloudflare client with your account ID and authentication tokens.
